name: CoW Protocol solver SwapGuard unprotected call
summary: A whitelisted solver's SwapGuard helper exposed an entry point that executed caller-supplied interactions with no access control, so the attacker routed a settlement through it and moved GPv2Settlement's DAI buffer to itself.

loss.notes: Gross loss is the exact DAI Transfer from GPv2Settlement to the attacker in the exploit receipt, valued at stablecoin par. This record does not substitute the larger contemporary headline estimate for the reproduced onchain amount.

ageReset.description: A solver settlement changed GPv2Settlement's DAI allowance for SwapGuard from zero to the maximum uint256, making SwapGuard's unprotected arbitrary interaction path capable of draining the fee buffer.

sources.note: onchain review: SwapGuard 0xcD07a7695E3372aCD2B2077557DE93e667B92bd8 created 2023-01-25T15:43:35Z by 0x37ec2a900632cea128f4c9ebc3a2a95659c2c567, unrelated to the attack sender 0xc0e82c1e...; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment (12.5 days). The tx receipt shows 114,824.89 DAI leaving GPv2Settlement 0x9008D19f58AAbD9eD0D60971565AA8510560ab41 for the attacker; the ~$166K headline figure covers the full set of assets taken. The settlement contract itself behaved as designed - the flaw is in the solver helper, so that is recorded as the victim contract.

Reviewed the exploit receipt and call trace, official post-mortem, commit-pinned reproduction, verified SwapGuard source, deployment trace, historical runtime, and the causal DAI allowance. SwapGuard.envelope is externally callable and executes caller-supplied interactions; the exploit trace calls it and then DAI.transferFrom moves exactly 114824.890807160711319588 DAI from GPv2Settlement to the attacker. The helper is a direct 2,445-byte runtime created at block 16484805, with hash 0x9cf5a334d9ef65d31610fcbc3c9082fad44b4f567ca5364a37eea7666cb6fcb0 both at deployment and immediately before the exploit. Code deployment alone was not yet sufficient to drain GPv2Settlement: transaction 0x92f906bce94bab417cccc87ae046448d7fb8c2c0350b7ed911545577acb3bfc1 later emitted DAI Approval log 2 and changed allowance(settlement, SwapGuard) from zero to the maximum uint256, so that causal configuration change resets age to 889,248 seconds.
